title: Fixed Half Guard Disc and Side Grip Angle Grinder
description: One newly authored complete static handheld right-angle disc-grinder appearance. A long faceted grip-shaped motor housing and rear cap connect to a short right-angle head. A perpendicular lower spindle and flange carry one solid blunt circular disc, partly enclosed by one continuous thick semicircular L-section guard with a real open front half. A lateral auxiliary handle has its own rooted stem and full grip, and a blank top switch completes the casing. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, one prop and zero scenes. No teeth, spark, cutting edge simulation, cable or powered internals; no rotation, grinding/cutting performance, operation instructions, protective effectiveness, compatibility, balance or safety claim. Not the old coaxial twin-wheel bench grinder scaled down or the dryer with a disk attached. Lowest disc is only a static display datum.
